summary.en: A Chinese AI agent platform in the OpenClaw ecosystem, focused on desktop automation and local workflow execution.
summary.zh: OpenClaw 生态中的中文 AI 智能体平台，主打桌面自动化与本地工作流执行。

title.en: Molili - OpenClaw Ecosystem AI Agent Platform | Get Model Key
title.zh: Molili（莫哩哩）- OpenClaw 生态智能体平台 | Get Model Key

description.en: View Molili official site and platform entry in the OpenClaw ecosystem.
description.zh: 查看 Molili 官方站点与平台入口，快速了解 OpenClaw 生态中的中文智能体方案。

benefit.en: Around 2,000 free points are available daily, with token usage often about 30%-50% lower than the original setup (subject to official policy).
benefit.zh: 每日可领取约 2000 积分，且 Token 消耗相较原版大约降低 30%-50%（以官方规则为准）。

notes.en: Strong OpenClaw compatibility with built-in domestic models, one-click no-code setup, and WeChat/DingTalk remote commands for lightweight workflows.
notes.zh: 对 OpenClaw 能力链路支持完整，内置国产模型，可一键完成零代码安装，并支持微信/钉钉远程下发指令；日常轻量任务基本够用。

en: Molili (莫哩哩) is a Chinese AI agent platform in the OpenClaw ecosystem, focused on desktop automation and local workflow execution.
It aggregates access to domestic models such as DeepSeek, MiniMax, Qwen, Kimi, and GLM for agent-style tasks, with WeChat/DingTalk remote command options noted in platform materials.
getModelKey lists Molili as a directory entry to the official site. We do not sell keys or run Molili accounts for you.
zh: Molili（莫哩哩）是 OpenClaw 生态中的中文 AI 智能体平台，侧重桌面自动化与本地工作流执行。
平台聚合 DeepSeek、MiniMax、通义千问、Kimi、GLM 等国产模型能力，并支持微信/钉钉等远程指令场景（以官方说明为准）。
getModelKey 仅作目录指引链到官网，不出售 Key，也不代管 Molili 账号。

en: Visit the official site https://www.molili.com.cn/ and register or sign in.
Follow on-platform setup for agent/OpenClaw workflows and any API or token entry the console exposes.
Review hub.cocoloop.cn or in-product docs for integration steps and model routing.
Keep credentials private; revoke them in the official product if shared by mistake.
zh: 访问官网 https://www.molili.com.cn/ 并注册或登录。
按平台指引完成智能体/OpenClaw 相关配置，并在控制台获取其提供的 API 或 Token 入口。
集成步骤与模型路由请查看 hub.cocoloop.cn 或产品内文档。
凭证请妥善保管；误分享后请在官方产品中吊销。

question.en: Is Molili the same as OpenClaw upstream?
question.zh: Molili 就是 OpenClaw 上游本身吗？

answer.en: No. Molili is a Chinese agent platform in the OpenClaw ecosystem with its own product surface and policies.
answer.zh: 不是。Molili 是 OpenClaw 生态中的中文智能体产品，有独立产品形态与规则。

answer.en: Platform materials highlight DeepSeek, MiniMax, Qwen, Kimi, and GLM. Confirm the live catalog on the official site.
answer.zh: 平台资料常见 DeepSeek、MiniMax、通义千问、Kimi、GLM；以官网当前目录为准。

question.en: Can I buy a Molili key on getModelKey?
question.zh: 能在 getModelKey 买到 Molili Key 吗？

answer.en: No. We only link molili.com.cn; obtain access through official channels.
answer.zh: 不能。我们只链到 molili.com.cn，请通过官方渠道开通。
